page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.8xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing the Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The processor includes a 35 MB L3 cache and supports instruction sets such as AVX, AVX512F, AES, and BMI2. The instance is configured with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, and it features a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear contrast between single-core and multi-core performance. Single-core metrics, including stress-ng and Geekbench single-core tests, fall into the weak category, with single-threaded gzip compression rated as poor. However, the 32 dedicated cores deliver average multi-core performance across stress-ng, Geekbench multi-core, and PassMark CPU tests. Memory bandwidth is stable, with cached read speeds reaching 1308.86 GB/sec and uncached write speeds at 49.01 GB/sec. Database operations, Redis SET operations, and static web serving throughput also perform within the average tier.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.sn2ne.8xlarge offers a balanced resource density suitable for legacy workloads that benefit from high core counts rather than high single-thread performance. Because it relies on an older Intel Xeon architecture and lacks local NVMe storage, it represents a stable, budget-conscious option for multi-threaded applications. Recommended workloads include general-purpose web serving, multi-threaded data processing, Redis caching layers, and moderate database operations that do not require high-speed local disk I/O.
